title: Telrad Networks
description: telrad.com zoominfo.com/c/telrad-networks-ltd/131956879 Telrad Networks (founded 1951 in Israel as The Consolidated Telephone & Radio Company) is a 75-year-old developer of wireless broadband equipment — TD-LTE/5G base stations, subscriber CPE, point-to-multipoint backhaul radios and private-network solutions for WISPs, telcos, industry and governments in 100+ countries. Its flagship BreezeCOMPACT base stations use software-defined radio (upgradable from WiMAX to LTE, 2×2 to 4×4 without new hardware) and its "LTE-in-a-Box" puts a full core network inside one compact unit; the newer BreezeAIR AXE line delivers 2+ Gbps links in the 6 GHz band. The company rose to prominence by buying Alvarion's broadband wireless division in 2013 ($6M) and went public on the Tel Aviv exchange in 2017 ($121M revenue) before being fully acquired and delisted in August 2022 by Liquid Intelligent Technologies / Cassava Technologies ($58M) — the pan-African tech group of billionaire Strive Masiyiwa.
